sloka: यदि वा ऽस्ति त्वभिप्रायस्तच्छ्रोतुं तव राघव ।समाधाय मतिं राम निशामय वदाम्यहम् ।। ७.३५.१८ ॥
transliteration: yadi vā 'sti tvabhiprāyastacchrotuṁ tava rāghava ।samādhāya matiṁ rāma niśāmaya vadāmyaham ।। 7.35.18 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, if you indeed have a desire to hear those deeds, then O Rama, concentrate your mind and listen, for I shall narrate them.
